body.condition: For a pre-treatment date in block \(\ell\), the untreated mean vector is \((a_{0\ell},A_{\ell\cdot})=(f_\ell^{\prime}\mu_0,f_\ell^{\prime}U_D)\); in the stable post regime, the untreated target and donor means are \((f_{\mathrm{post}}^{\prime}\mu_0,d^{\prime})\).

novel.justification: The known block-stable factor means, together with the row-span completion derived from the rank structure, are specialized restrictions of this paper; VivesiBastida2022PredictorSelection allows time-varying factors and is not support for this exact condition.
